snippet.title: Shunya - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Shunya is a 2D puzzle-platformer where you control a girl and a cat simultaneously. Draw magical cubes with the cat and harness the powers of Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind to solve puzzles and explore a mysterious pixel-art world. Check out the Shunya trailer to see what to expect ahead of the game's launch on PC.
